clue.text: Good heavens, what little bits!

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of mild surprise, like 'goodness me'
small fragments, as of bread or cake

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims in surprise at how tiny some pieces are.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a dated exclamation of surprise and the plural of a small fragment of food.

clue.text: The dog on the line is mine

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sitting on another comes above it, so first

parts.note: a collie is a sheepdog breed
RY is the abbreviation for railway, a line

explanation.surface: A dog standing on the railway line, said to belong to the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mine' looks like the possessive pronoun, but it is the noun: a coal pit.
explanation.definitionFit: A coal pit with its buildings and workings is a mine where coal is dug.

clue.text: Inexperienced, like those on remand

definitions.meaning: prisoners on remand are awaiting a court hearing, so have not yet faced a judge

explanation.surface: Prisoners held on remand are described as new to the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not tested is green and raw; a remanded prisoner has also not yet been judged in court.

clue.text: Song from The Gondoliers

parts.note: looks like a number from the Gilbert and Sullivan operetta, but means the kind of song Venetian boatmen sing as they row

explanation.surface: A request for a number from the Gilbert and Sullivan operetta.
explanation.walkthrough: The italics point to the Savoy opera; the answer is any song of Venetian gondoliers, whose rocking rhythm composers imitate.
explanation.definitionFit: A Venetian boatman's song, in a lilting rhythm, is the traditional gondola song.

clue.text: Sloth allows a detente to collapse

indicators.note: an agreement that collapses falls apart, so its letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Laziness lets a thaw between nations fall apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sloth' reads as idleness, but it is the animal; the letters of A DETENTE are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloth belongs to the toothless mammal order that also includes anteaters and armadillos.

clue.text: One daft note may ruin Yom Kippur

indicators.note: one silly wrong note could spoil a performance, so the letters are wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: A single foolish wrong note could spoil the observance of the Jewish fast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may ruin' signals the anagram of ONE DAFT NOTE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Jewish holy fast day of repentance is called by this English name.

clue.text: Stand up in honour of a weeping woman

indicators.note: in a down clue, making a word stand up writes it from the bottom upward, so backwards

parts.note: taken as written
the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: Rising in tribute to a woman in tears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stand up' turns only the word 'in', giving NI.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the mother whose children were slain wept until turned to a stone that still weeps.

clue.text: It's foolish when the ace takes a card below ten

parts.note: as can mean while or when
an ace is a one, written as the Roman numeral I
the card ranking just under the ten is the nine

explanation.surface: Someone thinks it silly when the ace takes a lower card in a game.
explanation.walkthrough: The ace is the number one, so I; 'takes' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Asinine means donkey-like, so stupid or silly.

clue.text: Commission book

definitions.meaning: to hire someone for a job
to reserve, as a band or a room

explanation.surface: A two-word order to book a commission.
explanation.definitionFit: To hire someone for work or to reserve their services are both senses of this verb.

clue.text: She couldn't be roused by Peg and Aunt Elsie, unfortunately

indicators.note: things going badly signals that the letters of these words are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Two relatives tried and failed to wake a sleeping girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' joins the fodder and is no part of it: BY PEG plus AUNT ELSIE are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The fairytale princess under a spell slept for a hundred years until a prince's kiss.

clue.text: Following the exact words left it really confused

indicators.note: muddled up, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A note saying that a quotation was garbled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' scrambles IT REALLY into ITERALLY, after L.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something word for word means sticking to the precise text, not its spirit.

clue.text: Due to succeed in return

parts.note: to return is to go back, so the word go is written backwards
to succeed is to win

explanation.surface: Something expected to pay off by way of a return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' is read indirectly as 'go back', so the word go is turned round; 'succeed' then sits within it.
explanation.definitionFit: Money that is outstanding and yet to be paid is said to be payable.

clue.text: One State cricketer to emulate

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
MI is the postal abbreviation for Michigan, a US state
Maurice Tate was an England fast bowler of the 1920s

explanation.surface: A single American state's cricketer seeks to copy another.
explanation.walkthrough: Maurice Tate was a famous England cricketer of the 1920s and 30s.
explanation.definitionFit: To copy someone's example is to follow their pattern closely.

clue.text: Putting Heather on a charge causes a sensation

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece put on another follows it

parts.note: a fee is a charge for a service
ling is a common name for heather

explanation.surface: Arresting a woman named Heather makes headlines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name; it is the plant, LING. A charge here is a fee, not a police one.
explanation.definitionFit: A physical perception or touch sense is what one experiences through the body.

clue.text: Bicycled round the cattle enclosure

parts.note: to have cycled is to have rode a bike
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Someone cycled around a cattle pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A roundup corral where cattle are gathered or branded, the sense behind the later cowboy show.

clue.text: U.s. doctors tell how to take it one at a time

indicators.note: to tell is to speak, so the phrase is spoken out loud

parts.words: how to take it one at a time
parts.note: taking things one at a time is doing them in turns

explanation.surface: American physicians explain how to do things one by one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in turns' when spoken matches the American spelling of junior hospital doctors.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage a junior hospital physician in training is called by this term.

clue.text: Professional soldier about to become Governor

indicators.note: about can mean around, so one piece goes round another

parts.note: a regular is a member of the permanent standing army
taken as written

explanation.surface: A career soldier is about to become a ruler of a province.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' reads as 'on the point of', but 'about' is the container signal and 'to' is taken as written.
explanation.definitionFit: A governor on an engine is a device that controls its speed.

clue.text: Compensated for drawback in the plant

parts.note: a reed is a tall waterside plant
the word draw read backwards, draw plus back

explanation.surface: Someone receives damages for a fault in the factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawback' looks like a fault, but splits as draw + back, giving WARD; 'plant' looks like a factory but is the reed.
explanation.definitionFit: To be paid back for a loss or effort is to be recompensed.

clue.text: Everything turns green in reaction to this

parts.note: all means everything

indicators.note: the word green turns into a new arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: An allergic reaction makes everything look green.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' rearranges GREEN into ERGEN; the whole clue reads as a description.
explanation.definitionFit: A substance that sets off an allergic response in the body is what triggers the reaction.

clue.text: What Satan begins with, say — gifts?

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: the name opens with a capital, a large S

explanation.surface: A riddle about the Devil's name and presents.
explanation.walkthrough: Satan begins with a capital letter: a 'large S', which said out loud is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Generous presents or bounty handed out freely, as a lord to his followers.

clue.text: It's a gift the French look for in an actor

parts.note: the gift of the gab is a talent for talking, so gab is the gift
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone looks for a talent in a performer, the French way.
explanation.walkthrough: Clark Gable was the Hollywood star of Gone with the Wind.
explanation.definitionFit: Clark Gable was the Hollywood leading man best known for Gone with the Wind.

clue.text: Purchase a cutter — sound form of transport

indicators.note: sound tells us that the words are heard, not spelt

parts.note: to buy a sickle, a curved blade for cutting crops

explanation.surface: Advice to buy a sharp blade, plus a sturdy means of travel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like an adjective meaning reliable, but it signals the spoken form of BUY SICKLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-wheeled pedal machine is a common vehicle for getting about.

clue.text: Current line of agreement

parts.note: AC is alternating current
a cord is a line or string

explanation.surface: A trend in the latest line of agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A harmonious settlement or treaty between parties is a pact.

clue.text: Framework of vehicle has protective covering

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
a case covers and protects what it holds

explanation.surface: A car's chassis has a protective shell.
explanation.definitionFit: A carcase can mean the skeleton or structural frame of a building or car.

clue.text: Article left out of year-book creates void

indicators.note: one piece is omitted from another word

parts.note: an annual is a book published each year
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Omitting an item from the yearbook leaves a gap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like the direction L, but 'left out of' signals the removal.
explanation.definitionFit: To cancel a marriage or contract is to declare it legally null.

clue.text: Walking stick disowned by Penang lawyer

definitions.text: Walking stick disowned by Penang lawyer

parts.words: Walking stick disowned by Penang lawyer
parts.note: a Penang lawyer is a kind of walking stick, so this is one named after a different Malay port, which a Penang cane would not claim

explanation.surface: A legal man from the Malay port denies owning a cane.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'Penang lawyer' is not a person but a palm-wood cane; the answer is a cane named after a neighbouring Straits port.
explanation.definitionFit: A rattan cane named after the Malay port and state is a classic gentleman's stick.

clue.text: Main part of viva voce, an easy test

indicators.note: only a portion of the words is used, the letters lying within them

explanation.surface: The bulk of an oral exam was simple.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' looks like an adjective meaning chief; it is the old word for the sea, which lies in VOCE AN.
explanation.definitionFit: The main is a poetic term for the open sea.

clue.text: Although not detected, the French one gets fairly warm

parts.note: un is French for one
something fairly warm is not iced

explanation.surface: Unseen, a French person gets somewhat hot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fairly warm' is read as NOT ICED.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that escaped attention passed unseen.

clue.text: Pluto acts in these shows

parts.note: Dis is a Roman name for Pluto, god of the underworld
theatre acts are parts of plays

explanation.surface: Disney's dog performs in some exhibitions.
explanation.walkthrough: Pluto looks like the cartoon dog or the planet; here he is the underworld god, also called DIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhibitions or presentations are things put on show.

clue.text: Fox's intimate

definitions.meaning: a member of the Quaker society founded by George Fox

explanation.surface: Someone's close companion is the fox's.
explanation.walkthrough: George Fox founded the Quakers, the Religious Society of Friends.
explanation.definitionFit: A Quaker follows George Fox's religious society; a close companion is a pal.
